BuildAsync.summary: Compiles modules and their import/include graph.

notes: BuildAsync(string) resolves the entry path through Compiler.SourceResolver.
BuildAsync() enumerates all sources from Compiler.SourceResolver.GetAllSourcesAsync.
Before module analysis, the compiler scans resolver-visible project .as files and loads standalone @global() declaration files when they exist.
@global() declarations are optional compile-time contracts for host globals and do not depend on import/include.
Enabled built-in bare paths resolve before project sources; relative imports continue to use the project resolver.
Resolved ScriptSourceReference.FullPath is the identity used for module graphs and runtime registration.
Sources without @module are anonymous; no default name is derived from a filename or path.
Only explicit @module names participate in name-conflict checks. An explicit project name that collides with another project module or an enabled built-in module fails during linking.

AuroraExportAttribute.summary: Marks a Core method, constructor, or public static readonly double field for generated script export.
notes: Use the parameterless constructor on at most one public constructor to enable script new.

Core methods may be static Type members or instance members. They may prefix ScriptContext ctx and ScriptObject thisObject. Script parameters support double, int, bool, string, ScriptDatum, ScriptObject subclasses, trailing defaults, and params double[] or params ScriptDatum[].
A CLR void return is a procedure. Direct native calls used as statements do not materialize a result; dynamic or exported calls observe script null, matching native func ... void.
params exports generate Datum adapters only; they are not compiler direct-call candidates.

patterns.summary: Put MemorySourceResolver before FileSystemScriptSourceResolver to let generated or unsaved sources override disk files whose resolved target falls under the memory root. Different protocols or non-overlapping roots are isolated.
Use a stable virtual root and map import paths to database records in ResolveAsync, then load text in GetSourceAsync.
Call BuildAsync(entryPath) when the host wants one entry plus its import/include graph.
Call BuildAsync() when the resolver should decide every source that belongs in the compilation.
Build once and create separate ScriptDomain instances for isolated executions over the same compiled code.
Use EngineOptions.WithBuiltIns to grant only the shipped or custom native modules required by the application before constructing AuroraEngine.
Use CreateDomain(global => global.Define(...)) to expose per-domain host services or state.

Implement static-only and constructible host Types with [AuroraNativeType] and [AuroraExport]. Select exact application types with CompilerOptionsBuilder.WithNativeTypes; they are registered once on the engine global and available to every domain. Hand-write matching declare type contracts in an @global() file for editor assistance. Implement INativeTypedDocument on a native instance type so script tdoc literals and host TDoc serialize/deserialize construct that NativeType directly.
Use AuroraEngine.RegisterType or ClrTypeRegistry.RegisterType to expose public CLR constructors and static members to scripts.
Use ClrMarshaller.ToDatum/ToScript for normal host values; use ScriptDatum factories when exact runtime kinds are required.
Use ScriptDatum.TypeOf or GetTypeName for script type names. Packed arrays and other native objects remain ValueKind.Object; Kind is not a complete type registry.
Use EngineOptions.WithRuntime to install a serializer, or call ScriptJsonSerializer directly for host-side inspection.
Catch AuroraCompilationException for compile diagnostics and AuroraRuntimeException for script stack traces.
Enable runtime hot reload and update a loaded module by its exact resolved full path; module names do not select patch targets.
Use CompileBlock for lightweight expression or statement bodies that hosts invoke directly without a module file.
Use BondingFunction and ClrDatumDelegate only for advanced callbacks that need raw ScriptDatum access.
